verdict.rationale: Docs show message-history objects that can be serialized/deserialized to continue a conversation (docs-7, comm-11), giving developers the raw material to persist context across sessions, but there is no built-in long-term memory store, vector index, or automatic cross-thread recall system documented. A production user explicitly notes they had to build their own 'history across turns' plumbing on top of Pydantic AI (pydantic-ai-comm-13), confirming this is a DIY capability rather than a first-class memory feature. Missing for 10: a documented persistent memory/session store, automatic retrieval across threads, and independent evidence that long-term cross-session memory works out of the box.
